methodologyNotes: Covers electric trolling motors for fishing boats and kayaks sold at a published US price. Includes bow-mount and transom-mount models; excludes gas kickers, outboard motors, and shallow-water anchor poles (Power-Pole spike anchors). Price is US MSRP or typical retail in USD for the base configuration. thrustLbs is rated static thrust in pounds-force at full power. voltageV is the DC system voltage the motor requires (12, 24, or 36); models offered in multiple voltages list the primary/highest option. shaftLengthIn is the reference shaft length in inches for the cited configuration (models ship in several lengths). mountType is an enum: bow, transom, or engine. controlType is an enum: hand, foot, wireless-remote, or cable-steer (foot = corded foot pedal; wireless-remote covers remote fob and app control). gpsAnchor is a boolean: true if GPS-based station-keeping (Spot-Lock, Anchor Mode, Anchor+) is built in or standard. maxAmpDraw is peak current draw in amps at full throttle; null if not disclosed. speedControl is an enum: variable (infinitely variable) or stepped (fixed speed settings). saltwaterRated is a boolean for manufacturer-rated saltwater use. weightLbs is motor assembly weight in pounds.

products.name: Power-Pole MOVE ZR
products.priceNote: Base 45" configuration price $5,249.99. Tackle Warehouse (retailer) lists the MOVE ZR Black 24V/36V 45" at "Price: $ 5249.99"; the manufacturer's own MOVE ZR page lists the 45" titanium-shaft configuration at $5,249.99 (52" = $5,449.99, 60" = $5,649.99). Note: the manufacturer store/buy page separately shows Power-Pole Direct pricing "As low as $5,349.99" for the base config.
products.provenance: The manufacturer product page (power-pole.com/move-zr) confirms this exact model as the "Move ZR" (SKU MV-ZR) and provides the full Specifications table used here: Max True Thrust 100lbs @ 36v / 78lbs @ 24v, Voltage 36v or 24v, Mounting Location Bow, shaft lengths 45"/52"/60" with the 45" weighing 53 lbs, GPS (Built-In) Yes with Anchor Mode, Variable Speed Control Yes (20 Speed Steps), and Usage rated Saltwater and Freshwater. Tackle Warehouse (retailer) independently corroborates the identical "Power-Pole MOVE ZR" spec table verbatim (100lbs with 36V, MOVE ZR 45" 53lbs, Bow / Scissor Mount, 20 Speed Steps) and prices the 45" base configuration at $5249.99, matching the manufacturer's own shaft-length price list (45" = $5,249.99). Model identity is unambiguous: both pages describe the same MOVE ZR trolling motor, not a sibling (PV / PV Offshore) variant. controlType is wireless-remote because the included foot pedal is a wireless REAL-FEEL pedal plus a Wireless Hybrid Remote and app control (not a corded pedal); speedControl is stepped because the spec states 20 discrete speed steps rather than infinitely variable; maxAmpDraw is null as neither page discloses peak amp draw.
